summary: This bill reauthorizes the PROTECT Our Children Act of 2008, extending funding for programs that combat child exploitation, modifying reporting requirements for the national strategy, and expanding the scope and liability protections for Internet Crimes Against Children (ICAC) task forces.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and amends the PROTECT Our Children Act of 2008, focusing on combating child exploitation. It strengthens the National Strategy for Child Exploitation Prevention and Interdiction, enhances the National ICAC Task Force Program, and increases funding for these efforts. The bill explicitly aims to improve investigations, prosecutions, and identification of child victims, and provides limited liability for ICAC task forces, all of which point to stricter justice and stronger policing in the context of child exploitation crimes.
